content.text: In regions where [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/get-payment-solutions-zimbabwean-digital-sellers-working-today|Get Payment]] platforms like Stripe and PayPal fail, digital [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-how-creators-ghana-get-paid-online-works|COREMERCH guide to creators]] are often left without a viable method to monetize their work. This guide addresses the pressing need for a robust [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-3|infrastructure]] to build a crypto store without reliance on traditional payment gateways. By leveraging Cloudflare Pages and the COREMERCH Edge Commerce Stack, you can deploy a fully functional online store that processes payments in cryptocurrencies seamlessly, ensuring you retain full ownership and control over your digital assets.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The COREMERCH infrastructure is built to combat the challenges posed by payment platform restrictions. Conventional payment gateways can hinder your ability to sell digital products, particularly in regions facing financial isolation. By utilizing Cloudflare Pages in combination with NOWPayments, you create a self-sustaining environment that circumvents traditional financial barriers. This infrastructure is not just a temporary fix; it provides a permanent solution that empowers you as a digital creator with complete sovereignty over your commerce capabilities.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before initiating deployment, gather the necessary resources for your store. You’ll need a Cloudflare account to host your site on Cloudflare Pages, a GitHub account for version control, and a NOWPayments account for processing cryptocurrency transactions. Additionally, prepare your digital products and any accompanying files for delivery. This groundwork ensures a smooth deployment process, allowing you to focus on your product offerings rather than the technicalities of setup.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Start by deploying your backend infrastructure using Cloudflare Workers, which will handle the logic for processing orders and verifying payments through NOWPayments. Once your backend is configured, integrate your file storage solution for seamless delivery—opt for options like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Ensure that your pipeline is fully operational by conducting thorough tests. This phase is critical, as it establishes the reliability of your payment processing and delivery mechanisms.
Own your digital commerce infrastructure outright, without dependency on third-party platforms.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

With your infrastructure fully set up, it’s time to go live. Promote your store through social media channels, leveraging your existing audience to drive traffic. Once visitors arrive, ensure that they can easily navigate your site and complete a purchase. After launching, monitor the first transactions closely to confirm that the payment processing and product delivery functions are working flawlessly. This step validates your setup and builds confidence in your operational capabilities.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully processing your initial transactions, consider scaling your operations. You can add additional products, enhance your marketing efforts, and even explore partnerships with other creators to broaden your reach. As you grow, continue to leverage the features of the Edge Commerce Stack, such as SPF/DKIM/DMARC configurations, to optimize your store's performance and security. This proactive approach will help you maintain a competitive edge in the digital marketplace.

The difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 is not which one works — both work — it is which one fits your situation. Stack 01 is the right choice if you want to deploy yourself, you are comfortable with Google Workspace tools, and your initial volume is under 100 orders per day. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete Stack 01 build with full source code and step-by-step configuration. Stack 02 is the right choice if you want the deployment done for you, you need higher volume capacity, or you want email deliverability infrastructure configured from day one. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy Stack 02 under your accounts in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Deploy your store with confidence, knowing all components are designed for seamless crypto transactions.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

The setup decision comes down to time versus depth. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything to build Stack 01 yourself in an afternoon or Stack 02 over a weekend — full source code, step-by-step configuration, and the NOWPayments integration guide. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH build Stack 02 for you in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, with SPF, DKIM, and DMARC configured for email deliverability. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. Both are at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Read the Sovereign Blueprint before you start configuring anything — understanding the complete architecture before touching any settings prevents the most common configuration mistakes. Create all required accounts first: NOWPayments, Cloudflare or GitHub, Supabase or Google account, Resend or Gmail. Then configure the backend with all credentials before deploying it. Then deploy the backend and confirm the endpoint is live. Then configure NOWPayments with the endpoint URL. Then build and deploy the storefront. Then configure your custom domain if using one. Then run the mainnet test. Then check the order database. Then — and only then — share the URL. The sequence is not arbitrary. Each step depends on the previous one.
Frequently Asked Questions
How can I ensure secure transactions on my store?
Utilize NOWPayments, which provides automatic on-chain payment verification with a low fee. This setup ensures that transactions are secure and efficient, minimizing the risk of fraud.
Can I customize my online store design?
Absolutely. With Cloudflare Pages, you can customize the design of your store using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. This flexibility allows you to create a unique brand identity.
What types of products can I sell?
You can sell various digital products, including ebooks, courses, templates, software, and more. The infrastructure is designed to accommodate a wide range of digital offerings.
Is there ongoing support after deployment?
Yes, with the Edge Commerce Stack, you receive 30 days of support following deployment, ensuring you have assistance as you navigate your new online store.
What are the benefits of using COREMERCH's infrastructure?
COREMERCH's infrastructure grants you complete ownership of your digital store without reliance on traditional payment platforms, providing a sustainable and sovereign commerce solution.
Experience full control over your digital products and their distribution, ensuring true sovereignty.
